summary: Frontend-only test of Fase 4 Bloque 1 'Regla de cobro' (Libro IGSS). Tested as superadmin: /igss/libro 5-figure resumen strip (matches GET /nogs/resumen exactly), 3 revision cards (sin_orden 52 == config, cirugias 71 == /cirugias-por-marcar total, detenidas == /en-curso-sin-movimiento?dias=90 total), sin-orden tabs, cirugias view (fecha, paciente, procedimiento, SPS / 'Sin orden (sin SPS)', 'N días'), Marcar realizada (toast, row disappears, count 71->70, completas +1 since the order became completa), detenidas view ('En curso' badge, '1 de 3 dosis', 10/01/2025), Cerrar sin completar dialog (empty motivo -> 'Indique el motivo'; confirm -> toast, row gone, cerradas 0->1). Patient ficha (PatientEditDialog in /pacientes): new estado labels, cerrar button only on en_curso, cerrada motivo text, 'Cirugía programada · 15/03/2026 (aún no realizada)' line. FOUND AND FIXED A CRITICAL BUG: the order-row action buttons in the patient ficha submitted the patient form. NOG unit dialog: totals use the new labels, avance shows 'X / 10' plus the desglose, order badges use the new labels. /igss/nog totals show numbers, cupos/desglose OK, Listado oficial label 'Desde (fecha en que se completó)' OK. No undefined/NaN. Mobile 390px: no page overflow, tables scroll inside their container. Roles: igss.admin can open /igss/libro; usuario is redirected to /pacientes.

minor.issue: It accepts an order that is already 'cerrada' (cerrada -> anulada, 200). Confirm this is intended. It changes the audit trail of a closed order.

ui_bugs.component: OrdenesIgssPaciente FilaOrden (inside the PatientEditDialog / Pacientes edit <form>)
ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER. The Editar, Cerrar sin completar, Anular and Reasignar buttons had no type='button'. They sat inside the patient <form>, so clicking any of them submitted the form: the patient was saved with the toast 'Paciente actualizado exitosamente' and the edit dialog closed together with the just-opened cerrar/anular dialog. Closing or annulling an order from the ficha was impossible. Fix: added type='button' to those 4 buttons.

The edit (pencil) button is still shown on 'cerrada' orders. Check whether editing a closed order is allowed by the backend or whether the button should be hidden.
